Cutting ₹2 lakh from the wedding budget: what could it become in 10 years?

₹2 lakh is one venue, decor or outfit upgrade at many weddings.
Invested for 10 years at an assumed 12% a year, ₹2 lakh grows to about ₹6.2 lakh.
The 12% is an illustrative assumption only: returns are not guaranteed, and real returns can be lower or negative.
